name: bowling-rooms
description: Self-hosted multiplayer ten-pin bowling for GameNest. Share a room code, bowl 3, 5 or 10 frames with 2 to 8 players. The server owns the pins: a release goes in, a deterministic 3D delivery comes out.

scripts.test: node test/run.js && node test/moderation.js && node test/plus_wallet.js && node test/roomcode.js
